## ✨ Added

- **Node backups can follow this instance's off-site copies.** A new switch in a node's placement, Copy off site with this instance's backups, sends the node's containers and folders to the same storage locations as this instance's own, on the same schedule. There they age by the node's keep rule and stay apart from this instance's snapshots. The node card shows where the copies go. Thanks to @LukasStipar for the idea.

## 🌐 Translations

- **The new switch and the node card's line in all 42 languages,** and the docs on nodes and off-site copies in all 26.
